steps.title: Get your gear ready
steps.say: This is a big, tough fight. Bring armor, a [sword](item:wooden_sword), a [bow](item:bow), lots of [arrows](item:arrow), food and blocks. Never sleep in a [bed](item:white_bed) in the End, because it explodes.

steps.title: Make eyes of ender
steps.say: Craft each [eye of ender](item:ender_eye) from 1 [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder) and 1 [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl). Make at least 12, plus a few spares, because some eyes break when you throw them.

steps.title: Find the stronghold
steps.say: Throw an [eye of ender](item:ender_eye) and follow it. Pick it up if it drops. When it flies down instead of up, dig down to find the [stronghold](place:stronghold).

steps.title: Open the End portal
steps.say: Place an eye in every empty portal frame. When all 12 have eyes, the portal opens. Jump in, then stay away from the edges and don't look at [endermen](mob:enderman).

steps.title: Break the crystals
steps.say: Shoot the crystals on the towers first, because they heal the dragon. For the 2 in cages, build up, break some [bars](item:iron_bars), then shoot from a few blocks away.

steps.title: Fight the dragon
steps.say: Shoot the dragon with [arrows](item:arrow) while it flies. When it lands on the portal in the middle, hit it with your [sword](item:wooden_sword). Stay out of its breath and purple clouds.

steps.title: Collect the egg
steps.say: Hit the egg once and it jumps to the ground nearby. Put a [torch](item:torch) 2 blocks under it, then break the block it sits on, so it drops for you.

steps.title: Go home
steps.say: When the dragon is beaten, the portal in the middle turns on. Jump in to go home. You'll come back at your [bed](item:white_bed), or where you first started.
